title: Q-ULTRA-country-snapshot-value-REDESIGN: every second-order step failed to bring The tenant's own declared value metric back in bounds; redesign
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** ladder exhausted for `country-snapshot:value`
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ultrastability --check
**Status:** open

The same failure three times is a design defect (GUIDING-DIRECTIVE section 2): change the structure, not the parameter.

size: L

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation ultrastability --tick` reads `country-snapshot:value` inside its bounds.
